tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of 10x16 pb seedlings at Anagwadi Nursery

itemList.description: Cost of raising 5"x8" seedlings for Transplanting into 10"x16"

Procurement of 1.91 cum farms yard manure/ compost 1.91 cum of sand and 3.82 cum redearthi.e totaiiy 7.64 cum. (ingredient ratio FYM: Sand Red earth =1:1:2) (8.72 cum needed for 10x16 minus 1.08 cum of transplanted 5x8 bag)
Mixing the ingriedient filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth
Transplanting of 5x8 size bagged seedlings into 10x16 size bags after removal of the seedlings along with the trimmed ball of earth.
Cost of collection of 8-10 ft long stakes of chewa or split dowgs bamboos from deparmental forest/ plantation for providing vertical support to each plant including delivery at nursery site.
Tying of plant to the vertical stake and pruning of buds as it grows once in a fornight.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01.11.2026 to 31-03-2027 ( 151 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene bagged seedlings.

Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset Purchase of Black sheet and other unforseen items and charges.
